title: A Meticulously Restored Icon of Italian Yacht Craftsmanship
description: Discover the 2008 Benetti Classic, a beautifully restored yacht blending classic style with modern amenities.
html:
The 2008 Benetti Classic stands as a testament to enduring Italian yacht design, presenting a blend of timeless elegance and meticulous craftsmanship. This 120-foot vessel has undergone an extensive restoration over the past six months, ensuring every system from hull to sun deck has been rebuilt, refurbished, or replaced. The attention to detail is evident throughout, with comprehensive documentation and photographic records affirming the quality of the work undertaken.

Her exterior features freshly restored teak decks and hull sides that gleam like new, reflecting the dedication to preserving her classic lines. Inside, the interior has been tastefully revived to its original luster, showcasing soft, natural wood floors and furnishings. This approach contrasts with the high-gloss, gold-trimmed finishes typical of Benetti yachts from this era, offering a more understated and refined ambiance. Powered by twin C32 diesel engines, the yacht cruises comfortably at 16 knots, balancing performance with luxury. The layout and design provide ample space for relaxation and entertainment, catering to discerning owners who appreciate both style and substance.

A notable highlight of this offering is the inclusion of a 37-foot tow tender, itself beautifully restored, along with two jet skis, two sea bobs, a rescue tender, and various charter toys. These additions enhance the yacht’s versatility for both family enjoyment and charter operations. The current owner’s motivation is clear, having acquired a larger 145-foot Benetti, underscoring a strong affinity for the brand. This makes the 2008 Benetti Classic a rare opportunity to acquire a vessel of this pedigree, fully updated and ready to deliver exceptional experiences on the water.

Located in the United States with US duty paid, this yacht embodies the blend of classic style and modern functionality that defines Benetti’s legacy. For those seeking a yacht that combines heritage with contemporary standards, this Classic is a compelling prospect.
